subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Should OpenClaw formally support `supportsReasoningEffort`, `supportedReasoningEfforts`, and `reasoningEffortMap` as Responses-provider compatibility configuration, including their upgrade and documentation contract?
rationale: The patch makes these fields available through the Responses model registry and uses them to alter user-selected provider request parameters; implementation tests establish mechanics but cannot choose the permanent public configuration surface.

options.title: Adopt the scoped compatibility contract
options.body: Accept these three Responses compatibility fields, require explicit provider declarations, and merge after refreshed current-head live proof demonstrates the outbound effort.

options.title: Keep Responses metadata narrower
options.body: Decline the new Responses configuration surface and retain the existing native/model-map capability behavior until a separately approved contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped compatibility contract
recommendation.body: Accept these three Responses compatibility fields, require explicit provider declarations, and merge after refreshed current-head live proof demonstrates the outbound effort.
